mine.text: Record myself playing along with the backing track

suggestions.text: Count-in clicks before the band starts
Tap a note in the sheet music to play from there
Speed trainer: loop gets a little faster each pass
Slow down or change key without changing the other (Amazing Slow Downer style)
Tuner using the microphone
Latency calibration so recordings line up with the band
Send a song as a link, so a collaborator opens the same chart
Recorded takes in the exported mix and stems
Hear yourself through the app while recording (try it, measure the delay)
Shared projects: songs and takes sync between collaborators (backend)
Hear-it loop: G boom-chuck from an attempt, blind A/B
Strum motion: bluegrass bounce vs pendulum A/B, then Irish on six strings
Band plays my recorded samples from the manifest
Guitar or mandolin tab under the melody (with capo)
Piano-roll melody editor: draw a tune, get ABC
Import a MIDI file as the melody, through the piano roll
Swap harmony options without restarting the band
Hum or sing a tune into the mic and get it written as ABC
Lyric chart: tap the word where each bar starts, instead of typing |
Light up each syllable as it's sung, on the chart and the sheet music
Read an ABC tune's own words (w: lines) into the chart
